name: Real relief, a test
note: The real relief's test map (docs/plans/done/m5-relief.md): small enough to compile for the sim. The Pratzen's western slope from the Austerlitz heightfield, set over the whole extent by a shift, a second piece from the Santon hill set in with a soft edge, a level edit on top and a brook that reads the real ground.
